items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Then Landry, from Landry to T-Boy, they led leader.

ctx.x: Well, Landry was the leader of the Tulane, huh? Uh-huh.

Landry was the leader of the Tulane. Landry was the leader of the Young, I mean, the Eureka. And then Willie Wilson was leader. Then Landry led. Then Landry, from Landry to T-Boy, they led leader. See, that's when leaders come down and then after T-Boy, then Poison. I see. Well, who managed the Young Tuxedo? John managed it himself. But he always considered whoever he hired for the Trump player, you know, was the leader. But he managed his own stuff. But didn't Rodgers get some of those jobs or someone? Ernie…
